title: s500-generic-44: Crossmodal face-name person-identity frequency tagging, SEEG of the left ventral temporal cortex (Volfart et al., 2020) (derivative)
description: Stereo-EEG (SEEG) recordings from the left ventral temporal cortex of patients with refractory epilepsy during a crossmodal frequency-tagging paradigm. Faces and written names of a famous identity were presented at 4 Hz, with a different identity inserted every 7th item (0.571 Hz). Face-only and name-only control conditions were also recorded. This derivative contains the authors' 30 Hz low-pass filtered, sequence-cut Letswave data for the 3 participants with non-empty files (Experiment 2 of the source article).
methods_description: SEEG was recorded with Micromed systems from 7 patients with refractory epilepsy at University Hospital of Nancy. Of these, 3 have usable data in the release. Stimuli were faces and written names presented at 4 Hz, with an identity change every 7th item (0.571 Hz). Conditions were FaceName, FaceOnly and NameOnly. Authors' preprocessing in Letswave 5: 30 Hz Butterworth low-pass (order 4), sequences cut from 2 s after onset to about 61 s and merged per condition. Data were repackaged to BrainVision format with Talairach electrode coordinates.
